disposition_reason: The results text prints mean ± SD lead for fresh farm milk, street-vendor pasteurized milk and a home-made milk confection from West Java; cadmium results are figure-only.

study.design: Exploratory survey with multistage sampling, descriptive analysis
study.origin: Pemulihan subdistrict, Sumedang (fresh milk); Pangalengan (confection), West Java, Indonesia

findings.notes: Unit not printed beside the mean; Figure 1 axis is ppm, the limit is stated in ppm, and the printed CV matches mean and SD, so ppm (mg/kg) is taken. Text says 83% contaminated and 53% above the 1.00 ppm limit; the abstract says 57%.

Unit not printed beside the mean; Figure 1 axis is ppm, the limit is stated in ppm, and the printed CV matches mean and SD, so ppm (mg/kg) is taken. Abstract: 67% of pasteurized samples contained lead, all below the limit.

Unit not printed beside the mean; Figure 1 axis is ppm, the limit is stated in ppm, and the printed CV matches mean and SD, so ppm (mg/kg) is taken. Printed product name is a regional milk confection (dodol milk); abstract says 60% contaminated with Pb and Cd above the limit. Basis of the confection value (fresh product) is not stated.

controls.control: processing of milk (fresh vs pasteurized vs confection)
controls.outcome: Pb mean 0.5578 ppm (fresh) vs 0.0047 ppm (pasteurized, different vendors) and 0.3173 ppm (confection, different producers); not paired samples

controls.control: milk container on farm (plastic bucket vs milk can)
controls.outcome: Text says plastic-bucket milk had higher Pb; no numbers printed

unresolved: Cadmium values exist only in Figure 2 (fresh milk mostly above 0.01 ppm, confection below); figure-only, not extracted.
Per-sample lead values exist only in Figure 1 (25 points for fresh/pasteurized, 18 for confection), which does not match n = 30 per product.
Abstract says 57% of fresh milk above the lead limit; text says 53%.
No collection dates, digestion method, LOD or quality control are reported.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Indonesian National Standard (INS 1998) lead limit for milk and dairy products
EPA (1985) cadmium limit used by the authors
